related: 9S-cytosolic aryl hydrocarbon (Ah) receptor non-ligand activated complex

definition: An aryl hydrocarbon receptor complex found in the cytosol, in which the ligand-binding subunit AhR is not bound to ligand; consists of AhR, two molecules of HSP90, the protein kinase c-Src, and the immunophilin XAP2/AIP.
label: cytosolic aryl hydrocarbon receptor complex
